text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days had passed since deciding to 
drop the Kikuka-sho from our goals. 
However, Eishin Flash still seemed 
bewildered—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ――Ah.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I need to reconsider the training 
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Because we had put together a 
long-distance menu specifically for the 
Kikuka-sho..."
choice_data_list: Shall we make some adjustments, then?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...However, I don't know the policy for 
adjustments. Yet changing one part will 
distort the whole."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Besides, there's a chance she might run in 
the Kikuka Sho...
choice_data_list: How about training just like that?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Still suited for long distances?
choice_data_list:
If we set our goal as the Arima Kinen, 
it'll fit the training menu.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me. Please let me think about 
it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For better or worse, she's single-minded. 
Now that the schedule is disrupted, she 
probably won't budge until she's satisfied 
with her own reasoning.
choice_data_list: (How do I give her that push she needs...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In order to give her an experience that 
would broaden her perspective right 
now—just as I thought that, Mr. C.B. 
suddenly came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B., who gave me valuable experience 
for the Derby by running alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps what she needs right now is also 
the 'experience' that comes after facing a 
setback."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then—a lively chorus of voices 
reached my ears.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, this much is easy peasy♪ Bring on 
some heavier dumbbells!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Who do you think I am? —I'm the invincible 
Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is Tokai Teio. An Umamusume who took 
on the Classic Triple Crown undefeated and 
claimed two crowns... only to skip the 
Kikuka Sho due to injury—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I asked Tokai Teio if she could talk 
to Eishin Flash, she nodded right away.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—You're asking... how I felt when I gave 
up on the Kikuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: I want you to tell me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer, that is—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, Flash. I'm the one who decided 
to talk about it, and it doesn't hurt."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Of course, it did hurt back then, 
though."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You know, there's someone I really love. 
Who do you think it is?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You mean President Symboli Rudolf, right? 
I often see the two of you together.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Correct! The reason I aimed for the Triple 
Crown was because I wanted to be like the 
President.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I was on such a roll, you know! 
Undefeated, won the Derby, and even got 
praised by the Prez!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I couldn't run. My dream just 
ended right there.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Yet here you are, still running today.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
How did you get back on your feet after 
straying from the path you'd chosen?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I wondered, what would Prez do in this 
situation?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If it were Prez, she definitely wouldn't 
give up here. She'd immediately look 
forward and keep on moving.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So I just did the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because I don't want the person I look up 
to to think I'm uncool!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: To the person... I look up to...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Why did you decide to talk to me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It's the same.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because if it were Prez, I know for sure 
she would've done this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After parting ways with Tokai Teio—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...I don't understand.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
What the person I looked up to—what my 
parents would have done... at that moment, 
I couldn't imagine it at all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to be like my parents, so I 
fulfilled my schedule completely."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yet that was just me copying how the two 
of them did things...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've strayed from that path, I 
just don't know... what the two of them 
would do.
choice_data_list:
Then how about thinking about "what you 
won't do"?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list:
Wouldn't you be able to think of something 
if it's the opposite?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Something those two would never do. The 
exact opposite of that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Regarding our next race—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Would you consider moving your schedule up 
by a year and running in the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup. One of the few races where 
Umamusume from overseas participate, 
gathering top contenders from both home 
and abroad.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Hearing you say that got me thinking, 
Trainer. About what the people I look up 
to—my parents—would never do."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If it's those two, they won't abandon the 
path itself. They will likely try to 
correct their course.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Because tearing up your entire planner 
just to discard a schedule you already 
decided on is simply not right.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then my way of correcting course... is to 
take on a challenge just as difficult as 
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup has the same venue and 
distance as the Derby. She has the 
experience, and with a one-month shift, 
her physical issues should be resolved.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In an autumn where the greatest talents of 
my generation face off with boundless 
spirit, I shall... compete against those 
in the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even if she somehow makes it to the Kikuka 
Sho, she must take on the challenge to 
make up for these wasted days.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup will certainly be a tough 
race. However—
choice_data_list:
You can hold your own even against 
Senior-level opponents.

You can definitely take on Senior Class 
opponents.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...To give those words some weight, let's 
hold a strategy meeting right away."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems you have saved me once 
again."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I was really in trouble. I 
didn't know how I should move forward from 
here...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Just like when competing with CB-san, 
incorporating a different perspective 
seems to lead to a solution.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"It seems I tend to jump to conclusions 
rather easily... This was very helpful."
choice_data_list: Beyond that, it's nothing but virtues.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Eishin Flash headed into the 
Japan Cup with a positive mindset.
